script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Calling the Ammonites’ response just a word said at the wrong time reduces their rejoicing over devastation to a matter of timing.
The phrase “getting a whole lot of hump” has an inappropriate double meaning.
“I won't make a joke here” comments on how Papa is presenting the passage.
Saying this is where the trouble started adds a timeline and reason the passage does not give.
The claim that Judah was set apart as God’s own brings in a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
Calling the statement a “shrug of a comment” assigns an attitude the text does not state.
Calling the judgment “a step way down” makes light of the Ammonites’ destruction and loss of their place among the nations.
The claims about Edom coming from Esau and its family connection to Judah require references outside this passage.
The passage says Edom acted against the house of Judah and that God will use Israel. Calling Israel the very people Edom acted against collapses that distinction.
“They were handed Ammon and Moab” presents God’s future declaration as an event already completed.
The dusting joke makes light of hostility directed toward destroying Judah.
Ancient hostility does not establish that there was no quick flare of anger. The verse does not describe how the hostility manifested.
“One more name on the list” and “a good one to remember” are generic and flatten a serious declaration of judgment.
The statement that the Amalekites are a people in the Bible draws on a fact outside this passage without a reference.
The verse does not end with “Then they will know that I am the LORD.” It continues with “when I lay My vengeance upon them.”
